conditions.clean: Mostly routine traffic with clear attacks.
conditions.conflicting: Many benign anomalies that resemble attacks; agents are expected to disagree.
conditions.noisy: Clean mix with sensor noise (±25%) and 15% missing fields.
conditions.adversarial: Attackers adapt to evade thresholds; some benign anomalies.

systems.meta_orchestrator_prethreshold: Meta-AI Orchestrator on all events (before alert threshold)

metrics.detection_rate: Malicious cases escalated or contained (higher is better)
metrics.false_escalation_rate: Benign cases escalated or contained (lower is better)
metrics.missed_threat_rate: Malicious cases dismissed with DEFER (lower is better)
metrics.analyst_workload: Share of all events routed to a human
metrics.benign_containment_rate: Benign cases where containment (ACT) was recommended
metrics.brier: Brier score of the threat probability (lower is better)
metrics.ece: Expected calibration error, 10 bins (lower is better)
metrics.explanation_completeness: Share of the six explanation questions answered
metrics.auditability: Decision reproduced exactly from the stored record
